Research over the previous twenty years has led us to a clearer
understanding of not only the body’s need for nutrition support 
during critical illness but also the role of nutrition in mediat-
ing the stress response. Planning nutrition care goes beyond 
the simple decision to feed the patient during critical illness; it 
is imperative to understand who to feed, what to feed, when to 
feed, and how much to feed.
Marcia Nahikian Nelms, PhD, RD, LD
